itemized.notes: Max Burdick, County Council District 6 (Republican), Year-End (January 31) report. LABEL vs FORM: index.csv carries election_year 2010 and date 2011-01-01, but the form is hand-dated '1-31-2012' at the top of the cover, signed 1-31-2012 and clerk-stamped JAN 31 2012 - it is the YEAR-END FOR 2011 (its two expenditures are dated 4-18-11 and 5-9-11). Transcribed from the form; the index dates are not corrected here, only flagged. Schedule A is a blank schedule (empty grid, diagonal strike, slashed-zero subtotal) - an honest zero. PRIVACY: the cover's street-address block is county-redacted; the cover's PHONE and EMAIL are printed unredacted and were not transcribed (out of scope for the row schema). CENTS CONVENTION: both amounts and the subtotal write cents as a raised superscript '00' over a rule; transcribed with a decimal point. Expenditure line 2 is a $300 contribution TO a political party, not a receipt.
